Dear John,

I hope this message finds you well. 

Please find attached the meeting minutes from our recent client meeting held on May 5, 2024. Below is a summary of the meeting:

- An agreement was reached on the project timeline and key milestones.
- We reviewed initial design concepts and collected feedback from the client.

Additionally, here are the action items agreed upon:
- Emma will update the project plan according to the client’s feedback.
- David will coordinate with the development team to initiate the first phase of the project.

Please note that the next meeting is scheduled for 2024-06-01.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
